name: 4-MeO-Butyrfentanyl
summary: Rare opioid and fentanyl analogue (not to be confused with Butyrfentanyl). There is very limited information online and little to no dosage information. Exercise extreme caution when using this drug. Overdose may result in respiratory depression. Do not mix with stimulants or depressants.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. As a fentanyl analogue, it is expected to act on the μ-opioid receptor, the main target of opioid painkillers.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。作為吩坦尼類似物，預期它會作用於μ鴉片受體，這是鴉片類止痛藥的主要作用目標。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。作为吩坦尼类似物，预期它会作用于μ鸦片受体，这是鸦片类止痛药的主要作用目标。

uses.en: It has been sold online as a designer opioid. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾在網路上作為設計師鴉片類藥物販售，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在网络上作为设计师鸦片类药物贩售，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the fentanyl analogues, cause drowsiness, nausea, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils. They can slow or stop breathing, and overdose is often fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的吩坦尼類似物會引起嗜睡、噁心、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小。它們可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，過量常常致命。長期使用會導致成癮與戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的吩坦尼类似物会引起嗜睡、恶心、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小。它们可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，过量常常致命。长期使用会导致成瘾与戒断反应。

fact.en: The fentanyl family began in 1960, when Paul Janssen's team in Belgium made fentanyl. This analogue adds a methoxy group to the benzene ring and swaps the propionyl chain for a four-carbon butyryl chain.
fact.zh: 吩坦尼家族始於1960年，當時Paul Janssen在比利時的團隊合成了吩坦尼。這種類似物在苯環上加了一個甲氧基，並把丙醯基鏈換成四碳的丁醯基鏈。
fact.zhHans: 吩坦尼家族始于1960年，当时Paul Janssen在比利时的团队合成了吩坦尼。这种类似物在苯环上加了一个甲氧基，并把丙酰基链换成四碳的丁酰基链。
